title: Tuscan White Bean Skillet
description: Creamy white beans simmered with garlic, blistered cherry tomatoes, spinach and rosemary in one pan. Serve with crusty bread.

image.alt: A skillet of white beans with tomatoes, spinach and garlic

steps.text: Heat the oil in the skillet over medium heat. Cook the shallot until soft, {time 3 min}, then add the garlic, rosemary and pepper flakes for {time 1 min}.
Add the cherry tomatoes and cook until they blister and start to burst, {time 5-6 min}. Press some with a spoon to release their juices.
Add the beans, broth and salt and simmer, mashing a few beans to make the sauce creamy, {time 6-8 min}.
Stir in the spinach until wilted, {time 1 min}. Remove the rosemary stem, add the lemon juice and serve with toasted bread.

notes: Not vegan? A spoonful of ricotta or grated Parmesan on top is lovely.
